aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.lead: A neighbourhood clinic where you always know what's happening, what it costs and who is treating you, with an assistant that answers when the front desk is closed.
story: Most people put off the dentist because they don't know what to expect: how much, how long, will it hurt. So we write it all down before you book.
Our assistant answers questions and books visits at any hour, and hands you to a real person the moment it should.
marquee: Gentle care · Clear prices · On time

values.title: On time

values.title: A human when it matters

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.lead: What we keep, why, for how long, and what the assistant can see. In plain words.
summary: We keep only what we need to book and treat you.
The AI never sees your name, phone or email.

sections.title: What we keep
body: Your name, date of birth, and a phone number or email, so we know who is booking and can reach you.
Your appointments: the treatment, the doctor, the time, and whether you came.
Your chats with the assistant, so the team can follow up if you need help.

sections.title: Why we keep it
body: To book, remind and treat you. That's it. We don't sell your data and we don't use it for advertising.

sections.title: What the assistant sees
body: The assistant reads your messages and can look up the clinic's services, prices and free times.
Before your messages reach the AI model, we swap names, phone numbers and emails for placeholders, so the model never learns who you are.
When you are signed in, it can see your own bookings so it can move or cancel them for you, and nothing about other patients.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Chats are deleted automatically after 90 days, unless someone from the team is still helping you with that conversation.
Appointment records stay as long as the clinic needs them for your treatment history.

sections.title: Your choices
body: You can make the assistant forget what it remembers about you, from your profile page.
You can ask us to correct or delete your details at any time.

sections.title: Contact
body: Questions about your data? Email {email} or call {phone}.
